verdicts.reason: A: a clean left column on a shared 48px edge, read in order (wordmark → two-line headline → subhead → chips → CTA), with original colours and circles kept. Its flaws are a large empty area at top right, the Honey Rosemary chip grazing the peach circle, and a CTA that is a little under-weighted at the bottom. B: the left edges don't line up (wordmark and subhead at about 76px, headline at about 64px). The headline runs to within about 30px of the right edge, so it feels cramped. The CTA floats mid-right, cut off from the copy. The flavour chips sit below the CTA in a detached bottom row, which breaks grouping and reading order. The top-right circle looks like a stray fragment.
